comparison.objective: Place a knife safely into a holder whose direct approach is obstructed.
comparison.physical_skill: Orientation-aware manipulation of a hazardous long object along a collision-free insertion path.
comparison.success_condition: Knife is securely stored without blade contact, collision, drop, or unsafe final exposure; detailed numeric tolerances are absent from the recovered board rubric.
comparison.reason: It tests safe constrained-path insertion of an intact knife, not impact fracture and containment of released fragments.
